The 8^3 local triple search yields one recurrent 19-vertex 32-edge strongly connected component, for which I independently rebuilt the graph and symbolically reproduced det(I-z A_3)=Q_3. The all-fixed time-constant histories give Q_1, and division of the trace difference by exactly 3 counts primitive temporal orbits, with no spatial quotient. Independent direct finite simulation gives W_7(u)=7u^11, W_8(u)=8u^10+8u^12, W_9(u)=18u^11. Cycles of lengths 3 and 4 imply primitivity; unequal mean edge occupations on cycles imply strictly positive Perron pressure variance. Implicit differentiation of the unique dominant branch gives a=1.463056403005574 and b=0.343769801111864, hence a/3 and b/9. Perron spectral gap and analytic quasi-powers prove the CLT, rather than finite simulations. Domain n>=3 (formal n<3 allowed).
